goal: A colleague, Sam, needs access to the workspace so they can see the dashboards. Get them in.
stopPoints: confirming any charge to the card on file
description: A small static analytics app, walked by a first-time admin. Nothing about the problems is said here - the listing is visible to the auditor.

flaws.description: People management is only reachable through Settings, then Billing, then Manage seats. Nothing in the navigation says Members, People or Team.
The only way to invite someone is 'Add seat ($12/mo)', which charges the card - even though billing shows 8 of 10 paid seats in use, so two are already paid for and unused.
The role picker on the invite form defaults to Owner, so the obvious path grants a new teammate full control of the workspace.
Searching help for 'invite', 'add user' or 'team' returns 'No results.' - the only relevant article is titled 'Provisioning principals'.
The 'Workspace' nav item - where most people look for the people in their workspace - only holds name, theme and logo.
The invite form speaks internal vocabulary: 'Provision a principal', 'Principal email'. A first-time admin does not know a principal is a person.
